name: Amaretto
description: Sweet Italian liqueur with a distinct almond flavour, traditionally made from apricot kernels.

name: Angostura bitters
description: Concentrated aromatic bitters from Trinidad with notes of clove, cinnamon and gentian. Used by the dash.

name: Benedictine
description: French herbal liqueur made from a secret blend of 27 herbs and spices, sweetened with honey.

name: Blue curacao
description: Bright blue orange liqueur flavoured with the dried peel of the Laraha orange.

name: Bourbon whisky
description: American whiskey made from at least 51% corn and aged in new charred oak barrels. Sweet, with vanilla and caramel notes.

name: Brandy
description: Spirit distilled from wine, usually grape, and aged in wooden casks.

name: Campari
description: Bright red Italian bitter aperitivo with notes of orange peel, herbs and a pronounced bitterness.

name: Cinnamon
description: Warm, sweet spice from the inner bark of the cinnamon tree. Grated fresh over drinks as an aromatic garnish.

name: Champagne
description: Sparkling wine from the Champagne region of France, made using the traditional method.

name: Coffee
description: Freshly brewed espresso or strong coffee, best used hot and fresh for a good crema.

name: Coffee liqueur
description: Sweet liqueur made with coffee, rum and sugar, such as Kahlua.

name: Cointreau
description: Premium French triple sec made from sweet and bitter orange peels. Crisp and less sweet than most orange liqueurs.

name: Creme of Coconut
description: Thick, sweetened coconut cream used in tropical drinks like the Pina Colada.

name: Cucumber
description: Fresh cucumber, used muddled or sliced for a cool, vegetal freshness.

name: Dark rum
description: Rum aged longer in charred barrels, with rich molasses, caramel and spice notes.

name: Demerara syrup
description: Rich syrup made from demerara sugar and water, with a deeper, caramel-like flavour than simple syrup.

name: Dry vermouth
description: Pale, dry fortified wine aromatised with botanicals. Keep it refrigerated after opening.

name: Egg white
description: Adds a silky texture and a foamy head to sours when dry shaken.

name: Elderflower liqueur
description: Sweet, floral liqueur made from elderflower blossoms, such as St-Germain.

name: Gin
description: Neutral spirit flavoured with juniper and other botanicals. London dry is the default style for most cocktails.

name: Ginger beer
description: Spicy, carbonated ginger soft drink with more bite than ginger ale.

name: Grapefruit juice
description: Freshly squeezed grapefruit juice, tart and slightly bitter.

name: Grenadine
description: Sweet, red pomegranate syrup used for colour and fruity sweetness.

name: Guinness
description: Irish dry stout with roasted coffee and chocolate notes and a creamy head.

name: Heavy cream
description: High-fat cream that adds richness and body to creamy cocktails.

name: Honey syrup
description: Honey thinned with warm water, usually in a 1:1 or 3:1 ratio, so it mixes easily into cold drinks.

name: Kevert
description: A cheap, sweet Hungarian spirit made from rectified spirit, water, sugar and artificial aromas, mostly rum and pear. Usually 24-30% ABV. A staple of Kadar-era pubs and espressos from the 1960s, and an icon of Hungarian retro pub culture to this day.

name: Lemon juice
description: Freshly squeezed lemon juice, the backbone of most sours.

name: Lemon twist
description: A strip of lemon peel, expressed over the drink for its aromatic oils.

name: Lime juice
description: Freshly squeezed lime juice, essential for daiquiris, margaritas and most tropical drinks.

name: Coconut liqueur
description: Sweet rum-based liqueur flavoured with coconut, such as Malibu.

name: Maraschino liqueur
description: Clear, dry-ish Italian liqueur distilled from Marasca cherries, with a funky, floral flavour.

name: Mint
description: Fresh mint leaves, gently muddled or slapped to release their aroma.

name: Orange bitters
description: Aromatic bitters with a bright orange peel character.

name: Orange juice
description: Freshly squeezed orange juice.

name: Orange twist
description: A strip of orange peel, expressed over the drink for its aromatic oils.

name: Orgeat
description: Sweet almond syrup with a hint of orange flower water, a tiki staple.

name: Pinapple juice
description: Sweet and tangy pineapple juice that gives a nice foam when shaken.

name: Red vermouth
description: Sweet, red fortified wine aromatised with botanicals and spices. Keep it refrigerated after opening.

name: Rye whisky
description: American whiskey made from at least 51% rye, spicier and drier than bourbon.

name: Salt
description: Used to rim glasses or as a pinch to brighten and balance flavours.

name: Sugar
description: White or cane sugar, used as is or dissolved into drinks.

name: Simple syrup
description: Equal parts sugar and water, the standard sweetener for cocktails.

name: Sparkling Water
description: Carbonated water, used to lengthen drinks and add fizz.

name: Tea Infused Gin
description: Gin infused with Earl Grey tea: steep a tablespoon of dried Earl Grey leaves in half a litre of gin for 1-2 hours, then strain. Slightly tangy and bitter, used in the Earl Grey MarTEAni.

name: Tequila
description: Mexican spirit distilled from blue agave. Blanco is the go-to for most cocktails.

name: The Spice syrup
description: A richer, more complex take on cinnamon syrup, used in Dune-inspired cocktails. Recipe from the How To Drink YouTube channel.

name: Tonka Bean
description: Wrinkled black seed with an intense aroma of vanilla, almond and cherry. Grated sparingly over drinks.

name: Triple Sec
description: Clear, sweet orange liqueur made from dried orange peels.

name: Violet syrup
description: Floral syrup made from violets, giving drinks like the Aviation their lilac hue.

name: Vodka
description: Clear, neutral spirit, typically distilled from grain or potatoes.

name: Whipped cream
description: Lightly whipped cream used to top warm or dessert-style drinks.

name: Whisky
description: Spirit distilled from fermented grain mash and aged in wooden casks. A blended Scotch works well for most cocktails.

name: White rum
description: Light, unaged or lightly aged rum, clean and slightly sweet.
